issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but no open bead tracks its implementation. Introduce the third dependency kind `verifies` alongside `blocks` (schema/migration, checkpoint and event encoding, `bead dep` CLI support, field-guide and `bead schema explain` entries), extend section 3.4 validation so cycle rejection covers the new kind, and add the advisory diagnosis: a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead is reported as an inverted verification gate by doctor/policy lint — never rejected at insert, never inferred from issue titles. Close with concurrency tests per the every-mutation invariant, unknown-field round-trip coverage for the new kind, and conformance updates. Field evidence: 45 inverted edges across two live workspaces, recurring at 4-6% of newly created beads.

New contract suite tests/mutating_command_event_contract.rs walks the live clap tree and requires every visible leaf command to carry an explicit Mutating/NonMutating classification: mutating commands are invoked once against a fixture workspace and must advance the live event sequence, non-mutating ones must not advance it and must not alter the visible issue set. issue.description:
Close the class rather than the instances. A test walks the section 5 command contract, invokes each mutating command once against a fixture workspace, and asserts the live event sequence advances by at least one.

The test must fail when a newly added mutating command ships without an event, so this defect class cannot recur. Label-mutation paths are included.

Acceptance:
- every mutating command in the plan section 5 table is covered
- adding a mutating command without an event fails the suite
- read-only commands are asserted not to advance the sequence

Refs: plan 6.2.1 P3, section 5; ADR-003.
issue.title: Enumerate mutating commands and assert each advances the event sequence

issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but no open bead implements it. Add a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship at edge creation, and add a diagnostic that reports an inverted verification gate: a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` the bead it blocks. The diagnosis must be strictly advisory — report the pair, never reject the edge at insert time, never alter claim eligibility (matching R021's posture), and never infer the relationship from issue titles under any circumstance. Where R023 `why` explanations are surfaced, include the declared `verifies` relationship. Tests: an inversion declared via `verifies` is reported; an ordinary acyclic `blocks` ordering is not; a title that merely contains a verification noun without a declared edge is not flagged; cycle rejection (§3.4) is unchanged; the diagnosis is visible in the relevant doctor/diagnostic output surface.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the `verifies` dependency kind and inverted-verification-gate diagnosis (R025, ADR-001)
